acceptanceCriteria: Hosted runs load the adopter's runner config, or the deviation is recorded per run with the differing keys.
A focused test covers an adopter config with a non-default setting.
body: Residual from lane cce-1022k (PR beamfall/corvint#1546, seal 1aa0691af). Hosted CCE prove runs execute with the runner config CCE generates rather than the adopter's existing Playwright config, so project settings (baseURL, projects, fixtures) can differ from the adopter's real runs.
title: CCE hosted runs use the generated runner config instead of the adopter's own
